annotation.title_clean: AI: UNESCO mobilizes education ministers from around the world for a co-ordinated response to ChatGPT
annotation.title_en: AI: UNESCO mobilizes education ministers from around the world for a co-ordinated response to ChatGPT
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news release on the first global meeting of education ministers (25 May 2023) on generative AI and ChatGPT. It reports a survey finding under 10% of schools and universities have formal AI guidance, and announces forthcoming policy guidelines and AI competency frameworks for students and teachers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Over 40 education ministers met to share policy approaches on generative AI in education
Survey of 450+ institutions: fewer than 10% have formal generative AI guidance
UNESCO developing policy guidelines on generative AI in education and research
AI competency frameworks for students and teachers to launch at Digital Learning Week, September 2023
Anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
